correctness.rationale: The exact normalized sharp-bound formulas are verified against arXiv:2204.02917v2 (8.2) and their associated known global optimizer uniqueness. The proof supplies uniform differentiable hyperbolic expansions, derivative signs, curvature estimates giving \(O((\log n)^2/n^2)\) root error, and compact-uniform limits of the three strictly convex loss profiles.
